scope: Actual original game update/physics/weapon/objective code; CPU fast-forward with ordinary HUD state refresh, no position/HP/outcome injection. Chromium initialization uses real WebGL2; any separately counted final screenshots also use that renderer; native desktop and touch-emulated UI controls are checked. Additional storage checks exercise a completed POW save and the actual Willard retry button, then explicitly invoke a failed retry debrief to verify isolation; that is not an additional mission success. Mission 11 receives up to 3,600 seconds of original update calls (360 batches) to allow a real offshore landing to reach capture and complete the camp and river route; Mission 8 also receives 3,600 seconds because its recorded successful strike reached the recovery leg at 1,800 seconds; other missions retain 1,800 seconds (180 batches). Not actual iPhone Safari, hardware FPS, or a full-speed screen recording.

verificationBudget.basis: The preserved 2200-second m11 proof physically reached custody, escaped the camp and continued downstream to 68,482m; the longer bound allows that progressing original route to finish.

events.detail: The carrier starts inside the radar threat envelope. The crew turns offshore at about 145 m terrain clearance; it waits until beyond 26.5 km before climbing into radar view.
ARM in flight. With speed already settled, the crew turns offshore and descends while the real seeker continues independently.
Radar suppressed. The crew climbs outside the site before the conventional attack. Above 1,600m the light gun ring cannot engage; the existing heavy flak remains dangerous.
Terrain obstructs the moving carrier approach. The crew climbs away, flies toward open water and uses the normal ejection and rescue controls.
